modelingNotes: Camp North End: 330 Camp Road — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-330-camp-road.ts

A one-storey flat-roofed outbuilding of the Army depot, between the Ford plant's south-west corner and the south warehouses, set square to the Ford plant's grid rather than the warehouses'; restaurants since the 2019 renovation. Its little neighbour at the east end is `clt-cne-generals-office`. A plain brick box 49 × 26 m with a bump on its south side, a pale coping, a white roof.
Identity: none beyond being one of the campus's original low brick buildings; it is modelled because the campus set is wanted whole.

Evidence: - OSM: way/324608444 (building=commercial, height 4, addr 330 Camp Road). No parts. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): roof 232.0 across the whole footprint; ground 228.0–228.4 on the south and west, falling to 227.0 along the north wall (y = 0 is 227.0, so the south wall stands 3.8 m and the north 5.0 m). - Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903102 (CAMP LANDOWNER LP): its buildings date 1943–1955 (face brick, concrete block); which year is this one's is not recorded per building. - Camp North End leasing brochure (2021, camp.nc): "330 Camp Road", 10,000 sq ft. - 2019 C-M Historic Landmarks designation report (MacRostie): the depot added "an assortment of smaller buildings, including a free-standing cafeteria and a dwelling for Army staff"; whether this is the cafeteria is not confirmed. - USGS NAIP orthophoto (public domain): the white roof, a dark recess at the west end.
No licensed photo was found (Mapillary has nothing inside the campus). Estimated or invented: the brick (the campus's), the windows and their spacing, the plinth; kept plain.
Frame: the Ford plant's grid (x along bearing 96.3°, y along 6.3°), placement bearing 6.3; origin at the outline's centroid, lng −80.8337665, lat 35.2464025. Kit: `clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts`.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-cne-330-camp-road", model "clt-cne-330-camp-road"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-cne-330-camp-road.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
